title: corylus avellana var. pontica
intro: Corylus avellana var. pontica, commonly known as Pontic Hazel, is a variety of hazel tree native to the Pontic Mountains region in Turkey and Greece. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to address various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Pontic Hazel are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory agent, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful for treating conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Pontic Hazel include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
